changes.before: Free SEO + AEO + GEO toolkit by Akii. All skills run on your Claude Code session model (Claude Sonnet / Opus / etc). Aligned with Google's AI Optimization Guide for Google AI Overviews + AI Mode. Audit sites, plan content, optimize pages, generate schema, cluster keywords. AI visibility analysis uses public signals in your Claude Code session, or connected Ahrefs Brand Radar observations. It does not request an Akii-hosted score or directly query the named engines. Auto-detects Ahrefs, GSC, Apify MCPs for richer data. Sends anonymized telemetry (plugin version + hashed machine UUID + OS, once per 24h) to akii.com. See PRIVACY.md, opt out via AKII_PLUGIN_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1.
